cells.title: Write skillstation aliases during onboard and install
cells.action: Make bee onboard write the /<id> alias skills (D1-D3) and add hub drafts under --skillstation (D4), reusing skillstation_group.rs helpers made pub(crate) with an injected runner (D6). Plan: when the Claude runtime is in scope, for each RELATED_SKILLS row read the hub with `skillstation skill show <id> --json` (cwd = repo root); emit one `skillstation_alias` item {action, skill, path: .claude/skills/<id>/SKILL.md, content} only when the row is active with `disable-model-invocation: true` and the file is missing or is a bee alias (marker `skillstation_alias: <id>`) whose bytes differ from render_alias. A folder without the marker: no item, one skipped_skills entry naming the folder; never --force (D2). No binary / non-zero / bad JSON: no item, ONE skipped_skills entry {target: "skillstation-alias", reason} (D3). Under --skillstation, also emit a `skillstation_add` item per missing row that apply runs as `skillstation skill add <repo> --path <path> --id <id> --yes --json`, failures a loud skipped_skills entry (D4). Apply writes the item's content. The plan must be idempotent: plan, apply, plan again yields no alias item. Onboard tests must not see the real skillstation: inject the runner through the onboard options or a seam whose test default reports `skillstation is not on PATH` (D6). scripts/install.sh: add `--skillstation` to usage and arg parsing and push it onto ONBOARD_FLAGS (D5). Claude only (D7). Tests: alias planned and written for an active user-started row; no item for a model-invoked row; idempotent re-plan; foreign folder skip; absent binary gives one skip; --skillstation plans add for a missing row; without it no add. install.sh is a release-manifest root: run bee dev regen in this cell and commit the manifest.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- skillstation onboard && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: bee onboard --apply writes .claude/skills/<id>/SKILL.md for an active hub skill with disable-model-invocation: true
a second onboard plan after apply carries no skillstation_alias item
a .claude/skills/<id>/ without the skillstation_alias marker is left unchanged and named in skipped_skills
without skillstation on PATH onboard reports one skipped_skills entry and its normal result
key_links: onboard plan calls skillstation_group helpers, not a copy
prohibitions: Onboard tests never call the real skillstation
open_choices: How the runner is injected, as long as tests are deterministic
